Medically Guided Facelift Protocol

The Natural Facelift Experience at Neva Clinic by J Park Team

Every procedure at Neva Clinic by J Park Team follows a comprehensive, medically guided protocol designed to prioritize patient safety, personalize every treatment plan, and achieve refined, natural-looking facial rejuvenation.

STEP 01

Examination & Consultation

Detailed clinical assessment, 3D facial analysis and comprehensive evaluation of facial laxity with Specialist Level I Dr. Tran Toan.

STEP 02

Pre-operative Health Assessment

Thorough pre-surgical health screening including blood panels, vitals, cardiovascular screening, and medical history verification.

STEP 03

Pre-operative Marking

Precise anatomical vector marking and incision planning hidden within hairline and natural ear contours for invisible scar healing.

STEP 04

The Natural Facelift Procedure

Sterile hospital-standard surgery addressing the deep SMAS layer and platysma under safe monitored local anesthesia.

STEP 05

Reveal Your Natural Results

Restoring youthful volume and defined jawline contours while ensuring smooth, dynamic natural facial expression without tension.

STEP 06

Follow-up Care & Recovery

Attentive post-operative nursing, specialized swelling management, red light recovery therapy, and continuous doctor check-ups.

STEP 07

Stitch Removal & Evaluation

Delicate suture removal at day 7–10, scar management guidance, and structured long-term beauty follow-up protocols.

Facelift Investment Menu

Facelift Investment at Neva Clinic by J Park Team

The cost is determined by four key factors and can only be accurately established after an in-person consultation and clinical assessment by the surgeon.

  1. Recommended Facelift Technique: A natural facelift may involve different surgical approaches, including SMAS facelift, deep plane facelift, or a more conservative mini facelift.
  2. Surgical Approach & Tissue Management: The technique addresses the SMAS layer, deeper facial tissues, platysma, and skin envelope to achieve refined rejuvenation.
  3. Current Facial Aging Profile: An untreated face differs significantly from a face that has undergone previous surgery. Planning is tailored to existing anatomy.
  4. Whether Additional Rejuvenation Is Performed: Complementary procedures such as a neck lift, brow lift, eyelid rejuvenation, or fat repositioning may be performed together.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are You Wondering?

Before surgery, the surgeon administers carefully controlled anesthesia to ensure your comfort throughout the procedure. During the operation, the treated areas remain fully anesthetized, allowing you to remain relaxed and communicate normally with the surgical team when appropriate. Once the anesthesia wears off, mild tightness, swelling, or tenderness may be experienced during the first 1–2 days and is generally managed with prescribed medication.
Many patients can return to light, non-physical work within approximately 10–14 days, depending on their individual recovery. If your work involves physical activity or prolonged exertion, additional recovery time may be recommended. Your surgeon will advise you based on your healing progress.
Recovery typically takes around 10–14 days, depending on your individual healing response and how closely you follow your surgeon’s instructions regarding diet, rest, and wound care. Most international patients stay in Hanoi for 7–10 days for stitch removal and clearance before flying home.
After your facelift, avoiding certain foods and drinks helps minimize swelling and bruising and supports smooth healing. We advise avoiding alcohol, high-sodium foods, smoking, sticky rice, water spinach, and unpasteurized seafood during the first 2 weeks.
The cost varies according to the surgical technique (SMAS, deep plane, or mini facelift), degree of facial laxity, and whether complementary procedures like neck lift or fat grafting are combined. Transparent pricing ranges from $999 to $1,999 USD under current promotions.
Most patients notice a gradual improvement as postoperative swelling subsides and the facial tissues settle. While a refreshed appearance is visible by week 2–3, final subtle refinement and soft tissue integration mature beautifully between month 1 and month 3.
A well-planned Natural Facelift addressing the deeper SMAS layer is designed to provide long-lasting rejuvenation rather than a temporary fix. Typically, results endure 7–10+ years, allowing you to age naturally from a significantly rejuvenated baseline.
In many cases, revision surgery may be considered, depending on the underlying tissue condition, scar placement, and the time that has passed since the original procedure. Dr. Tran Toan specializes in complex revision cases.
A Deep Plane Facelift repositions deeper facial tissues beneath the SMAS layer and releases key facial retaining ligaments, providing powerful midface and jawline lifting without creating tension on the skin surface.
Yes. Thin skin does not automatically rule out a Natural Facelift. In fact, deep structural SMAS lifting takes all tension off the delicate thin skin, protecting against visible contour irregularities.

Privacy Policy

Metropole Cosmetic Surgery Clinic ("we", "us") respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what information we collect when you request a consultation, how we use it, and the choices available to you.

1. Information We Collect

Your full name, phone number, and the condition you select in the consultation form. If you choose to share additional details with our patient care team, such as your medical history, current medications, or photos for a preliminary assessment, this information is also collected.

2. How We Use Your Information

To contact you about your consultation, provide a preliminary assessment and treatment quote, confirm and manage your appointments, and send you special offers only when you have agreed to receive them.

3. Health Information and Photos

We treat all health-related information and photos as highly sensitive. Photos you send are used solely for medical assessment and treatment planning. We will never publish your photos, including before-and-after images, on our website, social media, or in any marketing materials without your separate written consent.

4. Storage and Security

Your information is stored on access-controlled systems and can only be viewed by authorized staff directly involved in your consultation and care. We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.

5. Data Retention

We keep your information only for as long as necessary to provide our services, or as required by Vietnamese regulations on medical records. When it is no longer needed, your information is securely deleted.

6. Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties. We may share limited information with trusted service providers who help us operate our services, such as messaging platforms (e.g. WhatsApp, Zalo) or appointment management systems, and only to the extent necessary. We may also disclose information when required by law.

7. International Patients

If you contact us from outside Vietnam, your information will be transferred to, stored, and processed in Vietnam. By submitting your information, you acknowledge this transfer for the purpose of arranging your consultation and treatment.

8. Cookies and Website Analytics

Our website may use cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site and to improve your experience. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

9. Your Rights

You may request to access, correct, or delete your personal information, or withdraw your consent to receiving marketing communications at any time, by contacting us via our official WhatsApp number or email.

10. Patients Under 18

We do not knowingly collect information from individuals under 18 years of age without the consent of a parent or legal guardian.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.
